Yemen's Southern Transitional Council says it will dissolve after its head fled to UAE

stances_toward.note: The Southern Transitional Council was the UAE's main Yemeni client from 2017; it announced its own dissolution on 9 Jan 2026 a day after its leader fled to the UAE, and the dissolution is contested by its spokesman and by crowds in Aden. Kept as partner (the leader is in Abu Dhabi), cooling because the instrument is broken and Saudi Arabia holds the south. Bond affinity: a patron-client tie built on a shared enemy, Islah and the Houthis (our reading).

sources.title: Yemen's Southern Transitional Council says it will dissolve after its head fled to UAE
Saudi Arabia alleges UAE smuggled wanted Yemen separatist leader out of the country

stances_toward.note: The southern separatist movement that sat inside the PLC (al-Zubaidi was a vice-president) and in December 2025 seized Hadramawt and al-Mahra. The government expelled al-Zubaidi on 7 Jan 2026 and charged him with high treason, the STC announced its dissolution on 9 Jan (denied by its UAE-based spokesman), the Attorney General froze all STC funds on 17 Jun and Yemen's UN envoy asked the Council to sanction al-Zubaidi; yet loyalists rallied in Aden on the founding anniversary (4 May) and said the movement would rename itself the Arab South Transitional Council. Rival, not adversary: the government wants it disbanded and disarmed and has taken the Giants Brigades onto its own side, but its southern base (and the promised dialogue) is something to be co-opted, not destroyed; the sources never grade it. The grade is our reading (confidence C) and moves to adversary if STC loyalists take up arms again. Bond - grievance: the December 2025 seizure and the Saudi-STC violence of January.

relations_to.summary: The UAE built the Southern Transitional Council as its Yemeni client to hold Aden, Mukalla and the south; the STC announced its dissolution on 9 Jan 2026 (contested) a day after its leader fled to the UAE, and the UAE withdrew its forces on 30 Dec 2025 after a Saudi strike on an Emirati shipment at Mukalla.

UAE withdraws troops from Yemen after Saudi airstrike

relations_to.summary: The government wants the STC disbanded and disarmed and its forces absorbed: al-Zubaidi charged with high treason (7 Jan 2026), the Giants Brigades under Abu Zara'a al-Muharrami on the PLC side, all STC funds frozen on 17 Jun 2026, and Yemen's UN envoy asked the Council to sanction al-Zubaidi. The STC announced on 4 May a new name, the Arab South Transitional Council (Sana'a Center account); loyalists keep demonstrating against Saudi 'guardianship'.
